experiment: DEX table-index-shift regression (Phase B Step 5, item 2)
toolchain: apkforge-toolchain:pinned (Apktool 2.10.0, Android Build Tools 34.0.0, Docker-only, no host SDK)
procedure: apktool d (fresh decode) -> remove exactly one package of 9 smali classes (b/a, b/a$a..b/a$f, b/b, b/c) -> apktool b -> zipalign -p -f 4 -> apksigner sign (debug.keystore) -> apksigner verify -> APKForge inspect -> APKForge DEX diff
A no-op control (decode -> build, nothing removed) was built the same way to isolate apktool-recompilation noise from the class-removal effect.

old_raw_byte_hash.false_positive_rate: 234/367 = 63.8% of common methods, spanning 67 of the 99 untouched classes

acceptance_condition: PASS: the 9 deliberately deleted classes are reported as removed; the 99 untouched classes are reported as unchanged (0 false-positive code_changed) under the new normalized hashing, versus 67/99 classes falsely flagged under the old raw-byte hashing for the identical rebuild.
